latest_release.name: v15.0.2
latest_release.body:
Nextcloud 35.0.2 is included

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v15.0.2 -->

## What's Changed
### 🏕 New features and other improvements
* harp: reject any problematic bind-mount by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8863
* fix(Mastercontainer): give the AIO interface's CA a name of its own by @h4fnp in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8869
* aio-interface: show hint and button on login page if a user is already authenticated by @Zoey2936 in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8837
* build(Mastercontainer): remove php source tarball from the image by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8839
* fix(Mastercontainer): remove setuid and setgid bits from the image by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8857
* fix(Mastercontainer): do not make /root world-writable by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8858
* Nextcloud: remove additional imagick (not-required) dependencies by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8861
* build(Mastercontainer): copy composer from the pinned official image instead of piping the installer into php by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8860
* notify-push: trust the CAs from NEXTCLOUD_TRUSTED_CACERTS_DIR by @h4fnp in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8816
* fix(watchtower): always log at least on info level by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8810
* fix(imaginary): always log on info level by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8811
* refactor(Nextcloud): stop clearing app_install_overwrite on major updates by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8885
* aio-interface: hide upgrade button and checkbox by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8887
* fix(Mastercontainer): make the app code read-only for www-data by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8859
* fix(Apache): clear X-Real-IP request header in caddy by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8946
### 🐞 Fixed bugs
* fix(Nextcloud): temporarily disable lazy objects during upgrade by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8957
### 👒 Updated dependencies
* build(deps): bump nextcloud/nextcloud-appapi-harp from v0.4.5 to v0.4.6 in /Containers/harp by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8866
* build(deps): bump nats from 2.15.0-scratch to 2.15.1-scratch in /Containers/talk by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8846
* [Automated] Update psalm-baseline.xml by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8847
* talk container update by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8850
* build(deps): bump python from 3.14.8-alpine3.24 to 3.15.0-alpine3.24 in /Containers/talk-recording by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8872
* watchtower container update to v1.23.1 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8831
* build(deps): bump haproxy from 3.4.6-alpine to 3.4.7-alpine in /Containers/docker-socket-proxy by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8853
* PHP dependency updates by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8849
* [Automated] Update psalm-baseline.xml by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8881
* dependabot: disable dependency updates for docker-socket-proxy by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8884
* upgrade Nextcloud to v35.0.2 by @szaimen in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8888
* build(deps): bump nextcloud-releases/whiteboard from v2.1.0 to v2.1.1 in /Containers/whiteboard by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pull/8886
* build(deps): bump euro-office/documentser
